note: The constant 4nA^n/r (arity n+1 in [L]) is the same, and the proof telescopes over coordinate hybrids as in [M]. The separation hypothesis is placed on a t-thickened neighbourhood of K instead of on the hybrids alone, so [L] assumes more than [M].

snippet.text:
private theorem comparable (h : C.Makes) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n+1) → C.book.Token)
    {A r t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ A) (hr : 0<r) (K L : Set (Points (n+1))) (p N D : ℕ) (hd : D≤N) (H : Permit v A D N p)
    (he : ∀ y∈L, allFine C.S p (4*r) y) (hv : C.S.a D < r) (Ks : cthickening t K ⊆ L)
    (x y : positions (n+1)) (hy : tag (C.S.a N) y ∈ K)
    (hx : dist (tag (C.S.a N) x) (tag (C.S.a N) y) ≤ min r t) :
    dist (lifted C N p v x) (lifted C N p v y) ≤
      ((n+1:ℕ)* (4:ℝ)) *((A^(n+1)/r)*dist (tag (C.S.a N) x) (tag (C.S.a N) y)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For x, y with `dist(tag x, tag y) <= min r t` and every coordinate hybrid in a set L of separation 4r containing the t-thickening of K, `lifted` changes by at most `(n+1)*4*(A^(n+1)/r)` times the displacement.
